issue.title: Detached retry spawn can free the family's runner slot before the retry child claims it (same class as the monitor follow-up gap)
issue.description:
While diagnosing the monitor-to-follow-up runner-slot handoff race (fixed by the
"Keep the runner slot held across the monitor-to-follow-up handoff" tale plan), I
found the same accounting-gap class in the detached retry-spawn handoff.

Mechanism (shared with the monitor bug): `running_agent_slot_count`
(`src/sase/core/runner_slots/_admission.py`) only counts a family's slot while some
member record is live and "started"; a freshly spawned detached child does not count
until its runner records `run_started_at`
(`src/sase/axe/run_agent_runner.py` -> `wait_for_runner_slot` -> `claim()`), which
happens only after Python boot, bootstrap meta, and `#fork` xprompt expansion.

Retry path: `src/sase/axe/run_agent_retry_spawn.py::spawn_retry_agent` spawns a
detached child via `spawn_detached_child` (with `transfer_from_pid=os.getpid()` and a
`#fork:` resume prompt), after which the failing parent runner finalizes and writes
its done marker. From the parent's done marker until the child records
`run_started_at`, the chain occupies zero slots, so parked agents at the
`run_agent_wait_slots` gate (2s poll) can be admitted into the slot the retry child
is about to (re)take.

Unverified details to confirm at fix time (why this is sized large):
- whether the retry child record carries `parent_timestamp` (gate-exempt, so the
  over-cap race applies exactly as in the monitor case) or boots root-shaped (in
  which case it queues and the defect is instead that a retry can lose its slot to
  the queue mid-chain);
- exact parent finalize ordering relative to the spawn.

Not affected (verified): `sase pipe` continues in-process via
`continue_as_successor` (`src/sase/axe/run_agent_exec_pipe.py`), so there is no
subprocess-boot gap there. The monitor follow-up instance of this class is already
covered by the proposed tale plan and should not be re-fixed here; reuse the
successor-start wait helper that plan introduces (`wait_for_followup_started` in
`src/sase/shells/followup.py`) if it fits.

task_type_fields.impact: max_running_agents / %wait(runners=N) caps can be exceeded during retry handoffs (or a retry chain can lose its slot mid-chain), the same user-visible over-admission the monitor follow-up bug causes
task_type_fields.repro: Saturate max_running_agents with a parked waiter present; force a provider failure that triggers spawn-on-retry; observe running_agent_slot_count drop to N-1 between the parent's done marker and the retry child's run_started_at, admitting the waiter, then the child starts (or queues) - trace via waiting.json polling in src/sase/axe/run_agent_wait_slots.py
